summary.text: Shuvom Ghose is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 24, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ghose previously ran for the House in Hillsborough 11 in 2012 and 2016.

paragraphs.text: Shuvom Ghose first sought a New Hampshire House seat in 2012, when Ghose was defeated in the September 11 Republican primary for Hillsborough 11.
In 2016 Ghose and S. Daniel Mattingly were the Republican nominees for Hillsborough 11, and incumbents Elizabeth Edwards and Robert Walsh won the general election.
